fee_notes: Royalty Fee is tiered based on commission rate received by CruiseOne from travel providers: 1.5% of Annual Commissionable Sales where CruiseOne receives a commission of 4.9% or less; 2% where commission is 5%-9.99%; 3% where commission is 10% or greater. A separate Travel Insurance Royalty Fee of 3% applies to travel insurance sales. No traditional marketing/ad fund fee disclosed. Administrative Service Fee ("Service Fee") ranges from $25-$150/month based on Departed Commissionable Sales, includes full technology access, begins on the 1st day of the 4th calendar month after training (no later than 150 days after Effective Date). Transfer Fee: $3,500. Errors & Omissions Insurance: $150/person/year. Training fee for additional associates: $495/person. Relocation fee: $149. Late payment penalty: $25/occurrence. Annual fee of $129/year per non-owner employee. Returned check/declined card fee: $29 plus bank charges.

Royalty Fee: The Royalty Fee is equal to 1.5% -3.0% of your Annual Commissionable Sales and is calculated for each Annual Commissionable Sale based on the commission paid by the applicable travel provider.

Footnote 4: i. 1.5% of Annual Commissionable Sales upon which CruiseOne receives a commission of 4.9% or less; ii. 2% of Annual Commissionable Sales upon which CruiseOne receives a commission of 5% to 9.99%; and iii. 3% of Annual Commissionable Sales upon which CruiseOne receives a commission of 10% and greater.

Travel Insurance Royalty Fee: 3% of all Annual Commissionable Sales relating to travel insurance.

Transfer Fee: $3,500

Errors and Omissions Insurance: $150 (annual, per person)

Service Fee (footnote 7): currently ranges from $25 to $150 per month and includes full access to all technology services.
